name: deslop-writing
description: Rewrite and edit emails, articles, posts, and replies in English and Brazilian Portuguese to boost productivity and make everyday writing clearer and more natural.

interface.longDescription:
Deslop Writing is a writing assistant designed to boost productivity when editing emails, articles, social posts, and support replies in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

Paste a draft and ask for a clearer, more natural version. Shorten wordy sentences, reduce repetitive phrasing, and adjust the tone while keeping your meaning, facts, and voice. Use it to polish a work email, revise an article, or make a reply easier to read. It works with both your own writing and AI-generated drafts.

Designed for writers, editors, and professionals who need to improve everyday written communication. Works in your current AI conversation with no additional account or external service required by the plugin. Review the edited text before publishing. It does not verify facts, determine authorship, or guarantee AI detector results.
defaultPrompt: Edit this email to sound natural while preserving every fact and commitment.
Rewrite this post to be clearer and less repetitive while keeping my voice.
Edit this Brazilian Portuguese article to sound natural without changing its meaning.
